title: NiriZan: Continuous Evaluation Infrastructure and Python Framework for Production AI Systems
description: NiriZan is an open-source continuous evaluation infrastructure for production AI systems. It provides automated judge-drift attribution with fixed anchor sets, statistically rigorous regression gating (Mann-Whitney U with Holm-Bonferroni correction), multivariate structure-drift detection, trust-weighted health scoring, and CI/CD-integrated quality gates for RAG pipelines, AI agents, and LLM applications.
